notes: «وروى بعضهم» : an unnamed transmitter, kept in its place (rule 8)
«حدثنا بذلك أبو سعيد الأشج» : a second isnad carrying the same saying: its own group
«وهكذا رواه محمد بن إسحاق عن نافع عن ابن عمر» : another transmitter for the same saying: variant; the commentary on the Prophet's ruling and the other Companions is not a route of this saying
